newsitem.title: HUNGARY: GIROCREDIT TO BUILD ATS 460 MLN HOTEL IN BUDAPEST.
newsitem.headline: GIROCREDIT TO BUILD ATS 460 MLN HOTEL IN BUDAPEST.

text.p: Austria's Girocredit will build a 460 million Austrian shillings hotel in Budapest to be managed by Mariott International, news agency MTI reported on Monday.
A 300 million shilling loan towards the project would be given by an Austrian consortium including Raiffeisen Zentralbank, Landes-Hypotheken Bank Steyermark and Bankhaus Krentschker.
The owner of the hotel, planned to open on October 31, 1997, will be Vasudvar Hotel Kft, 80 percent owned by Girocredit and 20 percent by the local district council where the hotel is built.
The Mariott Residence Hotel will be managed by the same staff as the 356-room Budapest Mariott Hotel.
